quotes.quote: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Prices Must Be Guaranteed for Term
findings.fact: Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.
findings.business_implication: No price increases during the contract term; must account for cost stability.
findings.action_recommendation: Price with long-term cost stability in mind.

quotes.quote: Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.

findings.title: Termination for Unacceptable Replacement Devices
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.
findings.business_implication: If the GPS model becomes unsupported, the contractor must replace devices; if the Department deems them unacceptable, it can terminate.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure replacement devices meet Department standards to avoid termination.

quotes.quote: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if such replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.

findings.title: No-Cost Maintenance and Replacement Within 30 Days
findings.fact: If any devices are identified by the Department to require maintenance or replacement, not resulting from the negligence of any DTF employee, the devices and/or services must be provided to the Department at no cost within 30 days of the Department’s notification.
findings.business_implication: Contractor bears the cost of maintenance and replacement for non-negligent issues, with a tight 30-day turnaround.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for rapid response and include costs in pricing.

quotes.quote: If any devices are identified by the Department to require maintenance or replacement, not resulting from the negligence of any DTF employee, the devices and/or services must be provided to the Department at no cost within 30 days of the Department’s notification.

findings.title: Installation Completion Deadline
findings.fact: All installations must be completed no later than the end of Calendar Year 2019.
findings.business_implication: Installation schedule is tight; must coordinate with Department to meet deadline.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan installation resources to ensure completion by end of 2019.

quotes.quote: All installations must be completed no later than the end of Calendar Year 2019.

findings.title: Prohibition on Purchase of Tropical Hardwoods
findings.fact: The Contractor must certify that all wood products comply with Section 165 of the State Finance Law, which prohibits the use of tropical hardwoods unless specifically exempted. The bid may be considered non-responsive if not in compliance.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure that any wood products used in the contract are not tropical hardwoods or obtain an exemption, otherwise the bid may be rejected.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that all wood products to be supplied or installed are compliant with Section 165 of the State Finance Law, and if any tropical hardwoods are used, obtain the necessary exemption approval from the State.

quotes.quote: The Contractor certifies and warrants that all wood products to be used under this contract award will be in accordance with, but not limited to, the specifications and provisions of Section 165 of the State Finance Law, (Use of Tropical Hardwoods) which prohibits purchase and use of tropical hardwoods, unless specifically exempted, by the State or any governmental agency or political subdivision or public benefit corporation.
Any such use must meet with the approval of the State; otherwise, the bid may not be considered responsive.

findings.title: MacBride Fair Employment Principles
findings.fact: The Contractor must stipulate that it either has no business operations in Northern Ireland or will take lawful steps to conduct business in accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles and permit independent monitoring.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must confirm its operations in Northern Ireland, if any, comply with the MacBride Principles, or certify that it has no such operations.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the company's operations in Northern Ireland and ensure compliance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles, or certify that there are no such operations.

quotes.quote: In accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles (Chapter 807 of the Laws of 1992), the Contractor hereby stipulates that the Contractor either (a) has no business operations in Northern Ireland, or (b) shall take lawful steps in good faith to conduct any business operations in Northern Ireland in accordance with the MacBride Fair Employment Principles (as described in Section 165 of the New York State Finance Law), and shall permit independent monitoring of compliance with such principles.

findings.title: Reciprocity and Sanctions Provisions
findings.fact: Bidders with principal place of business in a jurisdiction that penalizes New York State vendors may be denied contracts if goods/services are substantially produced/performed outside NYS. The list includes South Carolina, Alaska, West Virginia, Wyoming, Louisiana, and Hawaii as of May 15, 2002.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must verify that its principal place of business is not in a discriminatory jurisdiction, or that its goods/services are not substantially produced/performed outside NYS, to avoid disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Check the current list of discriminatory jurisdictions and ensure that the bidder's principal place of business and production locations are not subject to these sanctions.

quotes.quote: Bidders are hereby notified that if their principal place of business is located in a country, nation, province, state or political subdivision that penalizes New York State vendors, and if the goods or services they offer will be substantially produced or performed outside New York State, the Omnibus Procurement Act 1994 and 2000 amendments (Chapter 684 and Chapter 383, respectively) require that they be denied contracts which they would otherwise obtain.
NOTE: As of May 15, 2002, the list of discriminatory jurisdictions subject to this provision includes the states of South Carolina, Alaska, West Virginia, Wyoming, Louisiana and Hawaii.

findings.title: Compliance with New York State Information Security Breach and Notification Act
findings.fact: Contractor shall comply with the provisions of the New York State Information Security Breach and Notification Act (General Business Law Section 899-aa; State Technology Law Section 208).
findings.business_implication: The bidder must have procedures in place to comply with data breach notification requirements under New York law.
findings.action_recommendation: Review and ensure compliance with the NYS Information Security Breach and Notification Act, including breach notification procedures.

quotes.quote: Contractor shall comply with the provisions of the New York State Information Security Breach and Notification Act (General Business Law Section 899-aa; State Technology Law Section 208).

findings.title: Procurement Lobbying Certification
findings.fact: By signing the agreement, the contractor certifies that all disclosures under State Finance Law Sections 139-j and 139-k are complete, true, and accurate. If found intentionally false or incomplete, the State may terminate the agreement.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure all lobbying disclosures are accurate to avoid termination for intentional misrepresentation.
findings.action_recommendation: Review all procurement lobbying disclosures for accuracy and completeness before signing.

quotes.quote: To the extent this agreement is a "procurement contract" as defined by State Finance Law Sections 139-j and 139-k, by signing this agreement the contractor certifies and affirms that all disclosures made in accordance with State Finance Law Sections 139-j and 139-k are complete, true and accurate. In the event such certification is found to be intentionally false or intentionally incomplete, the State may terminate the agreement by providing written notification to the Contractor in accordance with the terms of the agreement.

findings.title: Certification of Registration to Collect Sales and Compensating Use Tax
findings.fact: If the contract is defined by Tax Law Section 5-a, the contractor must make the required certification. Failure to do so or a false certification is a material breach and may result in termination.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure it is registered to collect sales and compensating use tax in New York State and provide the required certification.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that the company is registered for sales tax collection in NYS and be prepared to provide the certification under Tax Law Section 5-a.

quotes.quote: To the extent this agreement is a contract as defined by Tax Law Section 5-a, if the contractor fails to make the certification required by Tax Law Section 5-a or if during the term of the contract, the Department of Taxation and Finance or the covered agency, as defined by Tax Law 5-a, discovers that the certification, made under penalty of perjury, is false, then such failure to file or false certification shall be a material breach of this contract and this contract may be terminated, by providing written notification to the Contractor in accordance with the terms of the agreement, if the covered agency determines that such action is in the best interest of the State.

findings.title: Quote Response Form Must Not Be Modified
findings.fact: The Quote Response Form must not be modified; any alterations may result in disqualification.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must submit the form exactly as provided, without any changes, to avoid being deemed non-responsive.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure the Quote Response Form is used as-is and do not alter any part of it.

quotes.quote: Do not modify this form. Any alterations of the Quote Response Form may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.

findings.title: Quote Response Form Must Be Completed
findings.fact: Failure to answer all clarifications or questions may delay evaluation and may result in non-responsiveness and disqualification.
findings.business_implication: Incomplete responses can lead to disqualification, so all required fields must be filled.
findings.action_recommendation: Thoroughly complete all sections of the Quote Response Form, including Part A hardware and installation costs.

quotes.quote: Failure to answer all clarifications or questions may delay the evaluation of your bid and may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.
